frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Liquidity has three observable dimensions — spread (small round-trip cost), depth (size tradable at a quote), and resiliency (speed of price reversion) — and quoted, effective, and realized spreads each measure a different slice of the round-trip cost.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Measuring Liquidity: Quoted, Effective, and Realized Spread; Depth; Resiliency
